title: MATLAB Production Server Physical Schema
description: JSONSchema $defs for MATLAB Production Server large-format JSON encoding. All MATLAB values are encoded as objects with mwdata, mwsize, and mwtype fields. Small notation is not used.

MatlabValue.description: Any MATLAB value in large-format JSON encoding.

MwSize.description: Array dimensions. MUST have >= 2 elements. Scalar is [1,1]. All values >= 1. product(mwsize) MUST equal length(mwdata), or 2*length for complex types.

FloatElement.description: A float value: JSON number, or NaN/Inf/-Inf as string or {"mwdata":"..."} object. Only valid for double and single types.

IntegerElement.description: A plain JSON number. NaN, Inf, and -Inf are NOT permitted.

ComplexPair.description: [real, imaginary] pair for one complex element. First = real, second = imaginary.

FloatMwData.description: Flat array of float values in column-major order. May contain NaN, Inf, or -Inf. product(mwsize) MUST equal length(mwdata). COLUMN-MAJOR ORDER: for matrix [1 2 3; 4 5 6] (2 rows, 3 cols), correct mwdata is [1,4,2,5,3,6] — column 1 (1,4) first, then column 2 (2,5), then column 3 (3,6). WRONG row-major: [1,2,3,4,5,6].

IntegerMwData.description: Flat array of integer values in column-major order. NaN, Inf, and -Inf are NOT permitted. product(mwsize) MUST equal length(mwdata). Same column-major ordering rule as FloatMwData.

ComplexMwData.description: Array of [real, imaginary] pairs in column-major order. length(mwdata) MUST equal product(mwsize). Each pair corresponds to one complex element. COLUMN-MAJOR EXAMPLE: complex matrix [(1+2i)(3+4i);(5+6i)(7+8i)] has mwsize [2,2] and mwdata [[1,2],[5,6],[3,4],[7,8]] — column 1 pairs first, then column 2.

RealNumericBase.description: Base structure for all real numeric MATLAB types. mwtype and mwdata are supplied by each concrete type.

ComplexNumericBase.description: Base structure for complex numeric types. mwcomplex MUST be true and MUST appear first. mwtype and mwdata supplied by each concrete type.

MatlabDouble.description: MATLAB double array. See FloatMwData for encoding rules.

MatlabSingle.description: MATLAB single array. No small notation. See FloatMwData for encoding rules.

MatlabInt8.description: MATLAB int8 array. Values in [-128, 127]. See IntegerMwData for encoding rules.

MatlabUInt8.description: MATLAB uint8 array. Values in [0, 255]. See IntegerMwData for encoding rules.

MatlabInt16.description: MATLAB int16 array. Values in [-32768, 32767]. See IntegerMwData for encoding rules.

MatlabUInt16.description: MATLAB uint16 array. Values in [0, 65535]. See IntegerMwData for encoding rules.

MatlabInt32.description: MATLAB int32 array. Values in [-2147483648, 2147483647]. See IntegerMwData for encoding rules.

MatlabUInt32.description: MATLAB uint32 array. Values in [0, 4294967295]. See IntegerMwData for encoding rules.

mwdata.description: int64 values. Range [-9223372036854775808, 9223372036854775807]. Full 64-bit precision preserved — NOT converted to double.

MatlabInt64.description: MATLAB int64 array. Full 64-bit precision preserved in JSON. See IntegerMwData for encoding rules.

mwdata.description: uint64 values. Range [0, 18446744073709551615]. Full 64-bit precision preserved — NOT converted to double.

MatlabUInt64.description: MATLAB uint64 array. Full 64-bit precision preserved in JSON. See IntegerMwData for encoding rules.

MatlabComplexDouble.description: MATLAB complex double array. mwcomplex MUST be true and MUST appear first. See ComplexMwData for encoding rules.

MatlabComplexSingle.description: MATLAB complex single array. mwcomplex MUST be true and MUST appear first. See ComplexMwData for encoding rules.

mwdata.description: Flat array of JSON true/false values in column-major order. Only true and false permitted — no numbers or strings. product(mwsize) MUST equal length(mwdata).

MatlabLogical.description: MATLAB logical array. mwdata elements MUST be JSON boolean true or false only.

mwdata.description: Single-element array containing one string. For M-by-N char arrays the string contains all M*N characters in column-major order. EXAMPLE: ['ab';'cd'] -> mwdata:["acbd"] mwsize:[2,2] — column 1 chars (a,c) then column 2 chars (b,d). product(mwsize) MUST equal length of the string.

MatlabChar.description: MATLAB char array. mwdata is always a single-element JSON array containing one string whose length equals product(mwsize).

mwdata.description: Flat array of JSON strings in column-major order. Missing values encoded as {"mwdata":"missing"}. product(mwsize) MUST equal length(mwdata).

MatlabString.description: MATLAB string array. Each element is a JSON string or {"mwdata":"missing"} for missing values.

mwdata.description: Flat array of MatlabValue elements in column-major order. Each element MUST use large format. Elements may be of different types including nested MatlabCell or MatlabStruct. product(mwsize) MUST equal length(mwdata).

MatlabCell.description: MATLAB cell array. mwdata is a flat column-major array of independently-typed MatlabValue objects.

MatlabStructFieldValues.description: One MatlabValue per struct array element in column-major order. Length MUST equal product(parent mwsize).

mwdata.description: JSON object mapping field names to MatlabStructFieldValues arrays. All field arrays MUST have equal length equal to product(mwsize). Values in column-major order. EXAMPLE: 2-by-1 struct with field 'x': mwdata:{"x":[val1,val2]} mwsize:[2,1].

MatlabStruct.description: MATLAB struct array. mwdata maps field names to column-major value arrays. Empty struct arrays are not permitted.

mwtype.description: The MATLAB enumeration class name as returned by class() — e.g. "Colors". NOT the literal string "enumeration".

mwdata.description: Flat array of enumeration member name strings in column-major order. product(mwsize) MUST equal length(mwdata).

MatlabEnum.description: MATLAB enumeration array. mwtype is the class name from class(). mwdata contains member name strings in column-major order.

mwdata.description: POSIX milliseconds since 1970-01-01T00:00:00 UTC. NaT = NaN. datetime(Inf,...) = Inf. mwsize MUST match parent datetime mwsize.

MatlabDatetimeTimestamp.description: POSIX millisecond timestamp array. Used for TimeStamp and LowOrderTimeStamp in MatlabDatetime.

mwdata.description: Single-element array containing the metadata string. Empty TimeZone: mwdata:[""] mwsize:[0,0].

MatlabDatetimeMetaString.description: Char-encoded metadata string for MatlabDatetime mwmetadata fields.

TimeStamp.description: POSIX millisecond timestamps. mwsize MUST match parent datetime mwsize.

LowOrderTimeStamp.description: Optional sub-millisecond precision. mwsize MUST match TimeStamp mwsize if present.

TimeZone.description: IANA timezone name or empty string for unzoned datetime.

Format.description: MATLAB datetime format string e.g. "dd-MMM-uuuu HH:mm:ss". mwsize MUST be [1, N] where N = format string length.

MatlabDatetime.description: MATLAB datetime array. TimeStamp = POSIX milliseconds since 1970-01-01T00:00:00 UTC. NaT = NaN. datetime(Inf) = Inf. mwmetadata TimeZone and Format are required.

oneOf.description: Enumeration class name for empty enumeration arrays.

mwtype.description: Type of the empty array. struct is NOT permitted.

MatlabEmpty.description: MATLAB empty array []. mwdata:[] mwsize:[0,0]. struct is NOT a valid mwtype.
